dataset.name: QASPER v0.3 official test split
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0, as listed on the official Hugging Face dataset card
dataset.scope: new source papers within the previously studied QASPER benchmark family; not an independent benchmark family
dataset.use_rule: evaluate only the frozen selectors and segmentation rule; no tuning or data-driven rule changes after test scoring

question: Does sentence-preserving subdivision of over-budget paragraphs increase the visibility of human-annotated textual evidence under the same output-token budget, relative to intact paragraph units?

cohort.include: answerable questions with at least one textual evidence annotation that can be mapped to source text
cohort.annotation_handling: score each textual answer annotation as an alternative annotation, average annotation scores within question, then average questions; cluster bootstrap by source paper
cohort.float_evidence: exclude from the primary text-only endpoint and report its count separately
cohort.unaligned_evidence: exclude an annotation from the primary endpoint if any textual evidence item cannot be mapped to the paper; report alignment coverage and exclusions

candidate_units.baseline: original nonempty body paragraphs, preserving source order and offsets
candidate_units.treatment: paragraphs at or below 240 BGE-token units remain intact; longer paragraphs are greedily grouped into adjacent complete sentences with PySBD 0.3.4 English char-span mode, no cleaning, no overlap, source offsets retained; a sentence over 240 tokens remains intact and is flagged; if PySBD returns invalid or overlapping offsets, retain that source paragraph unsplit and flag a segmentation fallback
candidate_units.ranking: score every candidate unit independently using the same query and the same frozen zero-shot selector; no gold annotation enters candidate ranking
candidate_units.tokenizer: locally cached BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 fast tokenizer; unit cost excludes query and special tokens

packing.policy: rank candidates by descending score, break ties by earlier source position, retain whole units that fit and skip units that do not

outcomes.primary: mean per-annotation character recall over exact source-aligned textual evidence spans at 240 tokens
outcomes.primary_contrast: sentence-preserving units minus intact-paragraph units, paired within question and selector
secondary: fraction of selected and missed gold characters in source paragraphs exceeding 240 tokens
BGE query-candidate pair truncation rates, including evidence-bearing units
outcomes.interpretation_boundary: measures visibility of annotated textual evidence, not sufficiency of evidence, answer correctness, reader comprehension, or clinical/scientific decision quality

uncertainty.cluster: source paper ID; preserve all questions and annotations within sampled papers
uncertainty.primary_test: two-sided 95% interval for the 240-token BGE chunk-minus-paragraph primary contrast; no tuning based on this test

reproducibility.candidate_text: official QASPER test package retained locally and excluded from redistribution
reproducibility.raw_rows: save per-question, per-annotation scores and source IDs; do not publish paper text
reproducibility.reporting: report every prespecified endpoint and exclusions, including null or adverse results

engineering_amendment_before_scoring.reason: one QASPER paragraph produced overlapping sentence offsets under PySBD; the runner stopped before any model outcomes were produced
engineering_amendment_before_scoring.change: conservatively retain only a paragraph with invalid segmenter offsets as a single flagged candidate instead of attempting a lossy repair
engineering_amendment_before_scoring.analysis_status: pre-scoring engineering amendment; all such cases are counted and reported
